sentences.l2: 在银行业务中，贷款审批的核心环节是风控，即识别并防范潜在损失。
sentences.l1: In banking business, the core link of loan approval is risk control, that is, identifying and guarding against potential losses.

sentences.l2: 过去，信贷员主要凭面谈和纸质材料判断借款人是否可靠，难免带有主观色彩。
sentences.l1: In the past, loan officers mainly relied on interviews and paper materials to judge whether a borrower was reliable, which inevitably carried a subjective color.

sentences.l2: 如今，银行借助大数据构建信用评分体系：系统汇总借款人的收入、还款记录和负债比例，再通过统计模型换算成一个分数，分数越高，按期还款的可能性越大。
sentences.l1: Nowadays, banks use big data to build credit scoring systems: the system aggregates the borrower's income, repayment record and debt ratio, and then converts them through a statistical model into a score; the higher the score, the greater the likelihood of repaying on schedule.

sentences.l2: 银行据此预测违约率，决定是否放贷，以及额度和利率。
sentences.l1: Banks accordingly predict the default rate, and decide whether to lend, as well as the amount and the interest rate.

sentences.l2: 与此同时，反欺诈系统会实时监测异常行为，例如同一设备短时间内反复申请贷款，一旦发现可疑迹象便自动预警，交由人工复核。
sentences.l1: At the same time, anti-fraud systems monitor abnormal behavior in real time, for example the same device repeatedly applying for loans in a short time, and once suspicious signs are found, they automatically raise an alert and hand the case over for manual review.

sentences.l2: 不过，模型依赖历史数据，经济环境剧变时预测可能失准，因此必须持续校准。
sentences.l1: However, models rely on historical data, and when the economic environment changes drastically, predictions may become inaccurate, so they must be continuously calibrated.
